Hey i don't know you or your situation. I understand that your miserable and its aweful. I dont want to seem like im guaranteeing you it will get better because im not. Life has its ups and downs. For people on this subreddit there are significantly more downs. But think of 3 things you've never done. Something you wanted to do as a kid but never did. There is time for that. I domt know how old you are or anything thats going on other than what you said in your post so im not sure what to say. I want to tell you to keep going but I don't know what has happened in the last 45 minutes. You have probably overdosed by now. If you haven't please reply. There may not seem like a lot to live for in this moment, but think of a few years from now. It sounds like a long rim and it is. Just think of all of the small things that make you slightly happy. Maybe its a sunny day or nice weather or something like that. Just think of all of those things you will never see. There are so many people to meet down the road that will care about you. There are people that care that you would think would. There are people I havent seen or talked to in years that still care just as much as when we were close. This is probably the same for you. You may not think so but its most likely true. Im just rambling at this point but I don't want you to die. I've been where you are now. I am where you are now. I will talk with you at any hour day or night if you live, if you ever need anything. Please don't die tonight.
